scope: Independent read-only source and actual local validation evidence review; only this report was written. No tests, builds, credential access, app launch, remote mutation or production approval by verifier.

focused_regression.distinction: The harness exits zero because the actual XCTest process failed its intended responsiveness assertion. This is not a passing mutant test.
focused_regression.failure_assertion: MainActor must respond between worker entry and exit

swift_test_wrapper_attempts.classification: Real assertion failure in an incorrectly configured isolated runtime
swift_test_wrapper_attempts.diagnosis: CFFIXED_USER_HOME was omitted. The existing facade uses default Application Support storage, which the runtime policy denies before the injected dependency. Source, environment and zero dependency-call assertions support this diagnosis; the log does not directly print a staging mkdir errno.
Correct isolated CFFIXED_USER_HOME selected an uncached manifest. Compiling it under the outer runtime policy failed with nested sandbox_apply Operation not permitted.

swift_test_wrapper_attempts.resolution: Precompiled the isolated-home manifest with native SwiftPM build sandboxing outside the test runtime policy, then ran swift test --skip-build --skip-update --disable-automatic-resolution under the unchanged runtime policy and isolated home. No product repair or sandbox disabling.
